title: Data Sizes [db, dw, dd, dq]
description:
## Data Sizes
Assembly doesn't have types like `int` or `char`. You work with raw bytes. These directives define how much space data takes:

| Directive | Size | Name | C equivalent |
|-----------|------|------|--------------|
| `db` | 1 byte | Define Byte | `char` |
| `dw` | 2 bytes | Define Word | `short` |
| `dd` | 4 bytes | Define Doubleword | `int` |
| `dq` | 8 bytes | Define Quadword | `long` / pointer |

```asm
section .data
    my_byte  db 42        ; 1 byte:  0x2A
    my_word  dw 1000      ; 2 bytes: 0x03E8
    my_dword dd 100000    ; 4 bytes: 0x000186A0
    my_qword dq 5000000000 ; 8 bytes
```

Strings are just arrays of bytes:
```asm
    msg db 'Hello', 0    ; 6 bytes: H e l l o \0
```
